items: Added a new Raven's Eye portrait of Baelenys carrying Vhaemys.
The Known Chronicle now uses a vertical timeline on mobile, with visible chapter titles, dates and tappable chapter links.
Added Update Notes: a daily, dated record of site improvements, accessible from the homepage's Latest Updates section.
Mobile navigation now opens from the left, with a compact header for the site name, search, notifications and Taverns.
Renamed the forum to Taverns with a warm hearth-inspired theme and added it as the twelfth homepage shortcut.
Notifications now links directly to the Update Notes page, with a matching title style and a Back to Home button.
Opened sixteen chapter discussion threads and community topics in Taverns, with upvotes, Hasocash awards, moderation and reply notifications.
Unified release notes into one daily Update Notes archive shared by homepage and notification links.
Added conversations and scheduled replies to the Baelenys carrying Vhaemys portrait, with a verified Vhaemys account, mini portrait and family friendships.
Added comments across Raven's Eye images, memes and reels, with character portraits, pinned character conversations and community profiles.
Community profiles show friends, and Latest comments links directly to conversations; scheduled comments appear when their publication time arrives.
